verdict.rationale: Expensify ships AI features (Ask Expensify AI, SmartScan), so an AI-training opt-out is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence pack contains no documentation of any setting, policy, or contractual commitment that keeps user data out of model training. The community threads about MTurk workers handling receipts concern human processing of receipts, not AI training controls, so they neither support nor dispute this story.
